title: Usage intake retry matrix and schema-variant fuzzer
creator: Asha Patel
description: Improve reliability of console usage-event ingestion by introducing a configurable retry matrix for transient failures and a schema-variant fuzzing harness to proactively surface parsing/coercion regressions. This ticket pairs runtime-side behavior (backoff, circuit-breaker, targeted retries) with an automated test harness that injects realistic malformed/variant payloads into the pre-ingest pipeline to validate schema adapters, coercion rules, and soft-fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: New retry matrix implemented in intake-worker with per-tenant and per-route overrides
Fuzz harness can generate and replay 10k synthetic variants for a given event type and report failure-mode distribution
Schema adapter logs classify errors into: drop, coerce, quarantine, and backpressure-signal
Canary run for 24h with 5% traffic routed through new retry+fuzz pipeline shows <1% increase in 95th latency and no data loss
Dashboard panels (Grafana) added for retry counts, quarantined events, and coercion rates by event-type
technical_notes: Retry matrix: allow exponential and linear backoff profiles, max attempts, and per-error-code handling. Store per-tenant overrides in tenant-config with TTL so ops can tune without deploys.
Introduce a circuit-breaker that flips to fast-fail when downstream store (kafka/ingest shards) reports sustained >5xx for 30s; implement half-open probe interval.

Fuzz harness: standalone binary that reads canonical schema and produces variants: missing fields, additional fields, wrong types, truncated blobs, and shuffled array orders. Harness will tag variants with mutation metadata for easier triage.
Schema adapter: extend current coercion table with deterministic coercion rules and a soft-fallback that rewrites top-level fields to a quarantine bucket with provenance headers when coercion fails.
Observability: expose metric labels for mutation_type, origin (canary vs prod), tenant_id, route, and schema_version to allow drilldown in Console.
Performance: measure KV-cache hits for repeated synthetic prefixes to ensure harness doesn't artificially inflate caching behavior; add harness option to disable cache during some runs.
PR strategy: ship retry matrix feature-flagged behind tenant toggle and run canary with non-critical tenants first; fuzz harness runs in CI separate job and nightly against staging cluster.
tasks: Design retry matrix schema and tenant-config API
Implement retry logic in intake-worker and add feature flag
Build schema-variant fuzz harness with mutation generator
Wire metrics and tracing for retry/circuit-breaker paths
Create Grafana dashboard and alert rules for regressions
Run canary and collect 24h telemetry, iterate on backoff parameters
Write e2e tests for expected coercion behaviors and quarantine routing
